'''Light Bombers''' are a type of [[Mobs]], placed into the [[Pure Parasites|Pure]] Tier.

== ''Spawning'' ==
*Spawns in groups of 1 from [[Evolution Phases#Phase 8|Phase 8]] with a spawnweight of 5.
*Spawns in groups of 2 to 5 in the [[Parasite Biome]], with a spawnweight of 5.
*Spawned by [[Stage III Beckon|Stage III Beckons]].

== ''Behavior'' ==
Light Bombers are flying bombardiers.

*Their Ranged Attack is performed by them dropping Bombs, which destroy blocks and inflict Poison, [[Viral]], and [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]].
** It will not use this attack if the target is above the ground.
*In certain circumstances, Light Bombers can apply contact damage, though they make no effort to do so.
*Like other [[Pure Parasites]], Light Bombers can summon up to 3 [[Seizer|Seizers]] to support them.
*Like other [[:Category:Pure Parasites|Pure Parasites]], Light Bombers can use personal [[Dispatcher Tentacle|Dispatcher Tentacles]] to teleport.
*Light Bombers can break blocks that have their [[Hardness]] Value up to 5, with a 20 ticks cooldown and 2 Blocks range.
{{Variants|count=1|Breacher=BreacherLightBomber.png}}

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===

* Light Bombers, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.

=== ''Post Death'' ===

* On Death, Light Bombers have a chance to explode, releasing [[Remains|Pure Remains]] and an effect cloud of stacking Poison and [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]].
